items.title: CPE Begins Its Journey
items.description: CPE was established with a focus on CA education, beginning its journey as a professional education institution.

items.title: CA Academy
items.description: The institution continued strengthening its CA Academy and CA Intermediate programme.

items.title: All India Rank 5
items.description: CPE recorded an All India Rank 5, marking an important milestone in its professional-course results.

items.title: CPE Junior College
items.description: CPE expanded into Junior College education, bringing its commerce-focused academic approach to the Intermediate level.

items.title: CA Final
items.description: CPE extended its professional education journey to CA Final, strengthening its end-to-end CA pathway.

items.title: Junior Intermediate State 1st
items.description: CPE achieved a significant milestone with a Junior Intermediate State 1st result.

items.title: Growing Student Community
items.description: CPE witnessed significant growth in student environments, strengthening its position as a trusted name in commerce education.

items.title: Enhanced Infrastructure
items.description: New discussions, modern facilities and learning resources were introduced to provide a better learning experience.

items.title: Expanding Academic Excellence
items.description: Continued focus on academic innovation, faculty development and student success across CA and intermediate programmes.

items.title: Digital Learning Initiatives
items.description: Introduced digital learning support, online resources and technology-enabled academic tools.

items.title: Continuing the Journey
items.description: Empowering the next generation of commerce professionals with the same communication to excellence, discipline and student success.
